profile.bio: I'm **Anirudh Sharma**, an Android engineer. I ship Kotlin and Jetpack Compose apps with 100K+ downloads, including a real-time Android TV client on a platform serving 10,000+ concurrent users, and build the backends, payments and AI features behind them.
profile.contact_blurb: Open to senior Android and mobile roles, plus freelance builds: consumer apps, Android TV, React Native, or full-stack with a Node.js backend. Email is the fastest route; I reply within a day.

experiences.summary: Sole Android engineer for the company's consumer and in-store POS apps, Bengaluru.
points: Sole Android engineer, owning three apps end to end: Wholesale Mandi (100K+ downloads, rated 4.1 from ~7K reviews), Origin Fresh (10K+, rated 4.4) and the in-store POS app
Cut cold start by ~70% (from ~2 s) and app size from 40 MB to 17 MB with Baseline Profiles, R8 and resource shrinking, and removing unused native libraries; fixed memory leaks found with LeakCanary
Cut POS checkout for large orders from 6–10 to under 5 minutes with barcode scanning and catalog pagination, so store staff scan items into the cart instead of searching
Migrated the Origin Fresh app from XML to Jetpack Compose and defined its architecture (MVVM, Dagger-Hilt), with Room, WorkManager and Google Maps SDK
Built an AI recipe generator with the Google Gemini API, Razorpay payments with webhook-driven confirmation, and Remote Config feature flags for A/B-tested rollouts

experiences.summary: Real-time content discovery across phone and Android TV.
points: Built and shipped TLDR by LumioLabs (50K+ downloads), a content discovery app unifying movies, shows, music, and live sports across streaming platforms

Built the Android TV client in Jetpack Compose for live sports scores and match data, pushed in real time over Socket.IO by a backend serving 10,000+ concurrent users, plus an FCM flow to launch content on the TV from a phone
Co-designed the app's server-driven UI architecture with the engineering manager and senior engineers; reviewed the team's Android pull requests and mentored junior engineers and interns
GitHub Actions CI/CD for staging and production, cutting manual build and deploy time by 50%
Fixed a first-launch race where API calls fired before the microservices' base-URL config had loaded, by gating requests on it with a Coroutines Mutex

experiences.summary: Android plus the backend behind it, remote.
points: Built and shipped a live cricket scores app (50K+ downloads, rated 4.2) with ball-by-ball commentary, scorecards, schedules, and points tables
Built Node.js + MongoDB backend services and the Android client consuming them (Retrofit, Coroutines, Room, WorkManager), plus Firebase Auth sign-in, FCM push notifications and analytics tracking

experiences.summary: Three Android apps built from one shared multi-module codebase.
points: Worked on three apps from one shared multi-module codebase: anywhere.app (10K+ downloads), team chat and calls; AnswerConnect (10K+ downloads), a virtual answering service; and WellReceived, HIPAA-compliant patient messaging
Migrated high-traffic flows from Views to Jetpack Compose in the shared modules, shipping the new UI to all three apps in one change
Fixed FCM notification and in-app dialer bugs, and memory leaks affecting cold start
